notes: ROBOTS: https://www.otto.de/robots.txt fetched FIRST (HTTP 200, 2,148 bytes, profile chrome120) before any other request on the host and read in full. It has THREE groups. 'User-agent: *' disallows exactly /gate/, /onex/, /cdn-cgi/ and /149e9513-01fa-4fb0-aad4-566afd725d1b/2d206a39-8ed7-437e-a3be-862e0f06eea3/. 'User-agent: bingbot' adds /suche/. A third group stacks 'User-agent: GPTBot', 'ChatGPT-User', 'OAI-Searchbot', 'PerplexityBot' and 'Perplexity-User' and disallows /kundenbewertungen/, /gate/, /onex/, /cdn-cgi/ and the same UUID path - that group names OTHER vendors' agents, not ours, so it does not apply to us (specificity cuts both ways). There is NO group naming ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot or anthropic-ai anywhere in the file, and no Content-Signal line, so no Claude opt-out exists and there is no hard stop. No Crawl-delay is declared; probe.py's 2 s per-host gap was kept. Nothing disallowed was requested: no /gate/, /onex/, /cdn-cgi/, /suche/ or /kundenbewertungen/ path, and no UUID path. The sitemaps used are the ones robots.txt itself declares and are on the same host (www.otto.de), so no second robots.txt was owed. ACCESS: clean. probe.fetch() returned HTTP 200 on 148 of 149 category requests across rotating fingerprints (chrome120, chrome124, safari18_0_ios, edge101); the single failure is /baumarkt/sanitaer/duschen/rinnen/, an intermediate hub whose only child Duschrinnen was fetched successfully and IS recorded. No WAF, no challenge, no 403, no 429. Pages are server-rendered Svelte ('reptile') of 0.4-0.5 MB carrying the H1, the grid and the total inline. No reader prefix, no campaign parameter, no CORS proxy, no browser automation. TREE: from OTTO's OWN category sitemap, declared in robots.txt - https://www.otto.de/category-sitemap/sitemap_index.xml.gz -> the per-department files sitemap_baumarkt, sitemap_moebel, sitemap_dekoration, sitemap_heimtextilien, sitemap_wohnen, sitemap_haushalt, sitemap_lampen, sitemap_diy, sitemap_koerperpflege (186,173 s in total, of which only 2,990 are clean path categories - the rest are facet URLs of the shape ?raum=badezimmer&farbe=... which were NEVER requested and are never recorded). The path segments themselves encode OTTO's hierarchy, which is how the tree was walked; each page's own child-link strip was used to fill the three hubs the sitemap slice omits (/baumarkt/sanitaer/halterungen/, /baumarkt/sanitaer/duschen/rinnen/, /baumarkt/sanitaer/badaccessoires/wc-zubehoer/wc-sitze/). The bathroom department is /baumarkt/sanitaer/ ('Bad & Sanitär', 71,276) with 21 level-2 branches; the bathroom mirror branch is /dekoration/spiegel/ and bath furniture is /moebel/badmoebel/ and /moebel/schraenke/. 149 category pages were opened. QTY: the listing page's OWN rendered total - N Produkte - which resolves to the displayCount field of the page's inlined server payload (script data-kestrel-app="reptile.dundee", devalue-flattened). No estimate, no parent number reused, no siblings summed. VERIFICATION AND THE 500 CAP - THE CENTRAL FINDING ON THIS SITE. displayCount is HARD-CAPPED AT 500. This was proved three independent ways and is documented on every affected node in review: (1) on every node rendering exactly 500 the same payload carries a rankedCount strictly above 500 (Duschvorhangstangen 502, Bidets 509, Rasierspiegel 509, Handtuchringe 512, Urinale 545, WC-Becken 677), whereas uncapped nodes show ranked>display without touching 500 (WC-Deckelbezuege 245/241, Seifenschalen 942/808, Handtuchstangen 1882/1691); (2) two DISJOINT colour facets of Handtuchstangen - which unfiltered renders 1,691 - both render exactly '500 Produkte' while ending on different last pages (goldfarben 5, schwarz 7); two different result sets cannot both be exactly 500; (3) for every uncapped node the paging widget's last page equals ceil(displayCount/96) exactly (241->3, 808->9, 1691->18, 2,197->23), and for the 500-nodes it does not. 45 bathroom-relevant nodes render the capped 500 and therefore carry NO qty and sit in review, not rows - a knowingly-capped number is not an exact count (rule 26). They cannot be enumerated either: OTTO's paging is entirely client-side and the listing has no page parameter - ?p=2, ?page=2, ?o=96, ?o=120, ?l=2, ?offset=96, ?seite=2, ?startIndex=120 and ?pageNumber=2 were each tried and every one returned page 1 with an identical set of 116 product links - and browser automation is barred by the run-owner decision. The 37 recorded counts are all uncapped values and discriminate sharply (241, 302, 343, 378, 386, 411, 436, 446, 480, 546, 580, 599, 643, 715, 765, 800, 808, 810, 816, 897, 922, 1,183, 1,202, 1,238, 1,285, 1,367, 1,650, 1,691, 1,788, 1,884, 1,892, 2,024, 2,197, 2,475, 2,494, 4,133, 9,347) - no site-wide constant. Each recorded page's H1 was read and matches the node, and each recorded link is the page's own rel=canonical string. DEDUP AND THE CANONICAL BLIND SPOT: already_extracted() was run on all 37 recorded leaves - ZERO hits remain in rows. Nine already-extracted nodes are in review: Badmöbel-Sets, Waschbeckenunterschränke (twice, see below), Spiegelschränke and Badhocker from Furniture.xlsx, and Wandspiegel, Dekospiegel, Standspiegel, Barock-Spiegel from Final.xlsx. BLIND SPOT (a) BIT HERE: /moebel/badmoebel/waschbeckenunterschraenke/ is NOT in the exclusion index, but its rel=canonical is /moebel/schraenke/umbauschraenke/waschbeckenunterschraenke/, which IS - so it was caught only because rel=canonical was checked before trusting the dedup miss, exactly as the brief instructs. Two further canonical aliases were caught the same way and kept out of rows: /baumarkt/sanitaer/halterungen/ canonicalises to /technik/zubehoer/halterungen/ (a consumer-electronics mounts category, not bathroom) and /moebel/badmoebel/ canonicalises to /moebel/?raum=badezimmer (a room facet of the Möbel department, not a category). /baumarkt/sanitaer/badaccessoires/wc-zubehoer/wc-sitze/ canonicalises to /baumarkt/sanitaer/wc/wc-sitze/ - one node reachable by two nav paths, recorded once under the canonical (rule 28). RULE 24 / ROLL-UPS: 15 nodes carrying their own rendered total are emitted as grouping rows with blank qty and blank link because they have valid children - Bad & Sanitär (71,276), Badezimmer Accessoires (2,938), Bad-Aufbewahrung (2,011), Handtuchhalter (2,612), WC-Zubehör (3,122), Badarmaturen (7,634), Badewannen (2,402), Badewannenzubehör (2,212), Duschen (13,992), Badewannenaufsätze (517), Duschbrausen (1,853), Duschkabinen (2,888), Duschsysteme (2,270), Duschzubehör (2,653), WCs (5,588), WC-Sitze (4,490), Spiegel (5,247) and Kosmetikspiegel (846). INCLUDED / JUDGEMENT CALLS: Badspiegel (2,494) and Schminkspiegel (810) are recorded under rules 10/11 - they are mirrors, not lights. Barrierefreies Bad (897) is recorded as a bathroom fixture/accessory node. Waschtische (9,347) and Waschbecken (2,475) are recorded as rule 4 fixtures; neither is in the exclusion index and neither canonicalises into the Furniture tree. Three fixing nodes from the Sanitärinstallation branch are recorded under rule 17 because they are bathroom-fixture-specific - Ablaufgarnituren (715), Duschwannenfüße (302), Waschtischbefestigungen (343) - while the rest of that branch and all of Rohre and Warmwassergeräte are routed out as plumbing/appliance material.
